product.title: Private Amsterdam Red Light District and Food Tour

description.text: See the famous Amsterdam Red Light District on a private tour that orients first-time visitors in the Dutch capital. The route follows the UNESCO-listed Amsterdam Canal Ring past Oude Kerk and into Chinatown, with three Dutch specialties such as cheese, kroket, and stroopwafel. Private pacing keeps commentary honest about the neighborhood rather than a packed group circuit. The two-hour format is built for visitors who want canal-ring walking and tastings without joining a large food group. Stops include Oude Kerk, Chinatown, Amsterdam Canal Ring.
